_provenance.source: GET /repos/OmniNode-ai/omniclaude/commits/{sha}/check-runs?per_page=100 (paginated, UNFILTERED -- every row, not only the expected tuples) and GET /repos/OmniNode-ai/omniclaude/actions/runs?head_sha={sha}&per_page=100
_provenance.filter: no name filter at all: the layer-5 sweep is default-deny, so a fixture filtered to the expected tuples could not exercise it. Rows are reduced to the fields the resolver reads; workflow runs to id/event/name/path. Each head carries the FULL post-merge row set; the test derives the merge-time slice itself (started_at <= merged_at, what a pre-merge poller sees) so the filter is readable in the assertion rather than baked into the data. in_run_job_names is the ci.yml run's own job list for that head, the set the in-run layers own and the sweep subtracts.
